workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The accepted text shape creates dependent sections that need Long-Work Stewardship before multi-section drafting expands.
reroute_triggers: Artist collapses the sequence into one compact fragment, or the work expands into full long-form chapters.

writing_method.rationale: The output is a reader-facing sequence whose sections depend on each other.

medium_output_shape_recommendation.rationale: Separate dependent sections preserve key, room, and residue without resolving the threshold.
tradeoffs: A single prose poem would be compact but would hide part-to-part dependency.
An artist statement would explain the threshold more than the approved movement allows.

cultural_format_structure.name: Serialized Installment
cultural_format_structure.audience_promise: Each section changes the threshold pressure while preserving continuity.
cultural_format_structure.audience_hook: Begin with the key as an object that should solve the door but cannot solve the feeling.

parts.label: Opening pressure
parts.function: Make agency visible before it becomes costly.

parts.label: Residue
parts.function: Preserve withheld crossing as the final pressure.

cultural_format_structure.turn_or_payoff: The sequence pays off by refusing to turn possible entry into resolution.
failure_modes: sections can be read in any order without loss
the final section resolves the threshold

text_form.rationale: A prose sequence can preserve cumulative emotional movement while staying image-led.

voice_point_of_view.speaker: threshold witness
voice_point_of_view.point_of_view: close third person with restrained interiority
voice_constraints: hold the same sentence pressure across sections

structure_plan.structure_rationale: Three dependent sections let the text move from agency, to danger, to residue.

sections.section_job: Make the key feel usable and emotionally blocked.
sections.intended_feeling: the ache of almost having agency
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The object that should solve entry becomes proof that entry is emotionally blocked.
source_wording_notes: Preserve key and threshold imagery without quoting private source language.
sections.paragraph_distinction: This section stays tactile and object-led.

sections.section_job: Make welcome feel dangerous because the key has made return possible.
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The room that should welcome return increases the cost of crossing.
source_wording_notes: Keep the lit room concrete and avoid abstract safety language.
sections.paragraph_distinction: This section shifts from object to atmosphere.

sections.section_job: Stop before resolution and preserve the dependent sequence's pressure.
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The expected crossing never arrives; the ending holds the choice open.
sections.paragraph_distinction: This section is shorter and more withheld than the prior sections.

length_policy.rationale: A serialized prose sequence needs enough room for local movement and forward pressure across dependent sections.

source_wording_constraints: preserve threshold, key, light, and withheld crossing
fidelity_policy.rights_notes: Use only artist-provided source material inside this project.
fidelity_policy.rationale: The sequence should preserve source images and cumulative pressure without copying private phrasing verbatim.

publication_use.audience: artist and reviewer evaluating cumulative text continuity
publication_use.privacy_notes: Keep biography implied rather than explicit.

traceability_summary.note: Each text section maps to one dependent Beat and requires continuity before expansion.
